name: nest-monorepo
title: NestJS API + worker monorepo (Turborepo)
description: The nest-api and node-worker stacks as one Yarn 4 + Turborepo workspace: apps/api and apps/worker share one Prisma package (packages/db) instead of the worker copying the API's schema, one compose stack, turbo-pruned Docker images with a migrate target, and root CI that builds the images as a set.

hooks.title: seed each app's .env from .env.example
hooks.run: for d in apps/*/; do [ -f "$d.env.example" ] && cp -n "$d.env.example" "$d.env"; done; true

hooks.title: format (the feature strip leaves valid but unformatted code)
git init
hooks.run: git init -q && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: scaffold {{name}} from the nest-monorepo template'

nextSteps: Edit apps/api/.env — DATABASE_URL, REDIS_*, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and SMTP_* have placeholder values. apps/worker/.env needs the same DATABASE_URL and REDIS_*.
yarn dc:up && yarn dc:wait   # start Postgres + Redis
yarn db:migrate              # create the initial migration (runs in packages/db)
yarn dev                     # every app; the API on http://localhost:{{port}}/docs

prisma.title: Prisma ORM + Postgres (shared packages/db)
prisma.description: The schema, migrations and generated client live in packages/db and every app imports @scope/db/client. The client is generated as CommonJS and compiled, so the CommonJS API and the ESM worker load the same build. The API owns migrations; its db:* scripts run Prisma there.

observability.description: OpenTelemetry traces, logs and metrics pushed over OTLP from every app (built for OpenObserve; set OPENOBSERVE_URL/ORG/TOKEN, or any OTEL_* backend), plus Terminus health checks with a Prisma indicator in the API. Off at runtime until connected.

temporal.description: A TemporalService in the API that starts and queries durable workflows, Temporal's dev server in compose.yml, and (with app-worker) a Temporal worker running the workflows and activities in apps/worker/src/temporal. The worker image switches to Debian, since Temporal's native core does not load on Alpine.

docker.title: Docker Compose + images
docker.description: One compose.yml (Postgres, Redis) shared by every app, and a turbo-pruned production image per app built from the monorepo root, with a `migrate` target on the API image that runs prisma migrate deploy.

ci.description: Root Forgejo workflows: lint, typecheck, test and build every workspace on branches, the API's e2e suite on pull requests, and every image built and pushed under one shared tag.

app-worker.title: Background worker app
app-worker.description: apps/worker: a standalone TypeScript worker (BullMQ consumers, pino logging) reading and writing the API's database through the shared @scope/db client. The worker-* features only apply when it is on.

worker-queue.title: Worker: BullMQ consumers
worker-queue.description: Worker processes pulling from the same Redis queues the API produces to. Only with app-worker.

worker-browser.title: Worker: headless browser (Puppeteer)
worker-browser.description: For rendering or scraping pages that need JavaScript executed. Heavy: the worker image grows by roughly 800 MB (Chromium and its fonts). Only with app-worker.

worker-pm2.title: Worker: PM2 process manager
worker-pm2.description: ecosystem.config.cjs, and pm2-runtime as the worker image's entrypoint. Only with app-worker.
